hero.headline: Campaigns that win start with a plan.
hero.lede: JRC Political helps candidates and causes build a clear strategy, a message voters remember, and a campaign that runs on schedule from launch to Election Day.

consult_items.title: Next steps
consult_items.text: An honest take on what it will take to win

sections.name: Joanna Cattanach
sections.body:
Every campaign is different, but the ones that win share the same things: a candidate who knows why they're running, a message that fits the district, and a plan the whole team can follow. Joanna works side by side with her clients to build all three.

[One or two sentences on her experience: races worked, roles held, or results she's proud of.]

sections.heading: What I can do for your campaign
sections.intro: Hire me for the full campaign or for one piece of it. Every engagement starts with a conversation about your race and what it will take to win.

cards.title: Campaign Strategy
cards.text: A written plan built around your district, your voters, and your path to the number you need.

cards.title: Messaging & Media
cards.text: A clear story about why you're running, told the same way on doors, in mail, online, and in interviews.

cards.title: Candidate Coaching
cards.text: Preparation for the moments that decide races: debates, forums, endorsement interviews, and tough questions.

cards.title: Campaign Management
cards.text: Hands-on support that keeps the plan moving week to week, so you can focus on meeting voters.

sections.heading: How we'll work together
sections.intro: A simple process, so you always know what's happening and what comes next.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: We start with a free consultation about you, your race, and your goals. I ask a lot of questions.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: I put together a strategy with clear priorities, a timeline, and the numbers you need to hit.

steps.title: Execute
steps.text: We put the plan to work and adjust as the race changes, with regular check-ins until Election Day.
